card.name: Words leading into harmful or large effects
card.fires_on: Mixed spots just before a negative outcome or large figure: digits inside big numbers, and words like 'at', 'even', 'potentiate', 'warming' or 'tumors' in risk statements.

modes.label: Digits in big numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a large count of people, days or volume.

modes.label: Risk-statement words
modes.description: A word in a sentence about harm that may occur or be increased.
modes.example: may occur<< at>> any dose in susceptible individuals

modes.label: Enhancing verbs
modes.description: Verbs or nouns about worsening or enhancing a harmful effect.
modes.example: may potent<<iate>> this risk of bleeding

card.writes: It suppresses words like 'adverse', 'negative' and 'unfavorable', so it seems to lessen predictions of negative-effect wording next.
card.plain: It fires in sentences about harm or risk, and in big numbers, where a negative word could follow.
